summary: Clean Energy Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a securities purchase agreement effective September 9, 2026, with Walnut Capital, LLC. The company issued a convertible promissory note with a principal amount of $166,500 for a purchase price of $150,000, netting $150,000 for general working capital. The note matures September 8, 2027, carries a one-time 12% interest charge, and is repayable in 10 monthly installments of $18,648 starting December 8, 2026. Conversion is only upon default at 85% of the lowest closing bid price over the prior ten trading days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap and Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) shareholder approval for issuances exceeding 19.99%. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
